source_text:
3.12 Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς ὑδρωπικόν Στέαρ κορώνειον
σὺν οἴνῳ ˉγˉο κʹ ἐγχυμάτιζε θερμῷ, ἢ χερσαίου ἐχίνου καυθέντος τὴν σποδιὰν οἴνῳ
ἐγχυμάτιζε.
pass_a_gloss: 3.12 Of-Africanus: toward a-dropsical. Fat of-a-crow with wine ounces 20 drench warm, or of-land hedgehog having-been-burnt the ash with-wine drench.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward a dropsical. Drench with crow-fat together with twenty ounces of wine, warm; or drench with the ash of a burnt land hedgehog in wine.

choices.why: κορώνειον is the adjective of κορώνη (crow). Not a 'crowning' of tallow.
Same χερσαῖος ἐχῖνος as 3.1, against the sea-urchin (θαλάττιος) at 3.15. Not hand-made and not a sea urchin here.
Same Cesti drench as 3.5–3.8. Imperative of ἐγχυματίζω, not ἐγχύω 'mix'.
Lock abbreviation οὐγγία + numeral 20, same ˉγˉο as 3.14. Not an OCR junk token.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
